title: Comparisons with Porsche, Taycan, and Mercedes
summary: Reviews mostly mention Porsche, Taycan, or Mercedes as prior ownership or shopping context, with a few favorable competitive comparisons and one complaint about missing customizable drive settings versus Porsche.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle by saying it feels ahead of Audi and Porsche or by placing it favorably alongside luxury brands the reviewer has owned.

mixed.summary: The mixed review criticizes the lack of a fully customizable drive mode and explicitly compares it unfavorably with Porsche's individual settings.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention prior Porsche ownership, Taycan shopping plans, brand welcome materials, or range anxiety from a former Taycan without a clear sentiment toward the focal vehicle.

limitations: Many fragments are brief brand references or ownership history rather than direct evaluations of the focal vehicle.
The topic mixes competitor comparisons, previous vehicle ownership, purchase plans, and one software-feature complaint, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Examples are insufficient to draw broader conclusions beyond these specific mentions.
